visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde hair, wearing a white knit top with black trim and a black choker, sits at a table in a bright cafe, speaking expressively with hand gestures. (2) The scene shifts to the woman in an oversized blue sports jersey, sitting on a beige couch; she holds a smartphone to her ear while clutching a yellow stuffed toy, then looks off-camera to speak. (3) She returns to the cafe setting, seen in a close-up as she brings a spoon of tiramisu to her mouth and continues speaking with a gentle expression. (4) Back in the living room, she lies on the couch looking intensely at a smartphone screen, her expression changing from curiosity to distress. (5) In a final outdoor phase, she is walking on a paved sidewalk lined with trees, wearing the blue jersey; she stops to point and shout toward someone off-camera, her face displaying anger and frustration. (6) The video ends with her walking away from the camera down the sidewalk.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, medium-tempo electronic BGM. A female voice speaks in a sweet, gentle tone. (2) A sharp telephone ring SFX occurs, followed by the female voice shifting to a more conversational and slightly urgent tone while talking on the phone. An off-screen male voice briefly interjects with a questioning tone. (3) A soft 'ding' notification sound triggers a new phase; the female voice starts reading names with rising pitch and intensity. A dramatic 'whoosh' and loud impact SFX lead into the voice becoming loud and confrontational, yelling with high arousal. (4) The BGM shifts to a more tense, rhythmic beat as the female voice continues to shout outdoors, punctuated by ambient street sounds like distant traffic. (5) A final comedic sound effect plays at the end with a slightly descending pitch.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous social media skit contrasting a girlfriend's behavior 'before' and 'after' a relationship has been established. It uses three specific scenarios—prioritizing the partner vs. friends, checking phones, and looking at other attractive people—to create a comedic effect through exaggerated transitions from sweet/understanding to intense/jealous.
